How Do I? 
Welcome to The Town of Wilton 
Welcome to our historic small town nestled in the Monadnock region by the Souhegan and Stony Brook rivers. With friendly people, a vibrant arts community and modern infrastructure, it offers an affordable and ideal living, working and recreational environment. Explore the many attractions on this site and see the fun things to do if you wander into Wilton! 
Online Services  
 Click the icon to access online services for vehicle registration renewals, vehicle estimates, dog re-licensing, property tax and  utility payments, vital records requests, Fire Department applications and requests and Building Permits.
